headword: {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}

definitions.gloss: working oneself to the bone; giving one's all
definitions.explanation: To exert oneself to the utmost, sparing no effort. Literally means 'grinding one's bones and crushing one's body.'

examples.japanese: {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}の{努力|どりょく}で{目標|もくひょう}を{達成|たっせい}した。
examples.english: I achieved my goal through tireless effort.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{会社|かいしゃ}のために{粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}{働|はたら}いた。
examples.english: He worked himself to the bone for the company.

examples.japanese: {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}して{家族|かぞく}を{支|ささ}えてきた。
examples.english: I have devoted myself entirely to supporting my family.

notes:
YOJIJUKUGO ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}): This is a four-character compound idiom.

WRITING:
- {粉|ふん} - powder, to grind
- {骨|こつ} - bone
- {砕|さい} - to crush, to break
- {身|しん} - body

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}する (to give one's all)
- {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}の{努力|どりょく} (utmost effort)
- {粉骨砕身|ふんこつさいしん}して{働|はたら}く (to work tirelessly)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {全身全霊|ぜんしんぜんれい} (with all one's heart and soul)
- {一生懸命|いっしょうけんめい} (with all one's might)
- {死|し}に{物狂|ものぐる}い (desperately, like one's life depends on it)

REGISTER: Formal, often used in writing or speeches.
